intent: Semantic group of fields with a legend and optional description. This is the form group.
useWhen: Related fields that need a shared heading, like billing or profile
A checkbox or switch sitting under a group legend
Form chrome — FieldSet is the form; do not invent Form
doNotUseWhen: A single labeled control — use Field
Page title — use PageHeader or Card title

children.note: kit Field, Checkbox, Switch, or RadioGroup

requirements: legend is the accessible name of the group

doNot: Do not invent FieldLegend, FieldGroup, FieldSeparator, Form, or FormDisplay — FieldSet is the form group
Do not nest FieldSet unless the inner group is truly nested
snippet: <FieldSet legend="Billing Address" description="The billing address associated with your payment method"><Checkbox id="same" label="Same as shipping address" /></FieldSet>
